THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 10 · Dark pool
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Still black water fills the cave. Pale broken shells crunch along the bank, and a slow stream slides away beneath a low opening to the northeast.

The bank's shells crunch beneath a careful step, while the black water gives little sense of its depth. The stream's low northeastern opening draws your eye away from the pool. Following it would mean approaching stone and water that conceal what lies beyond.

Ask the players

Do you sound the depth, secure a rope, search underwater, or follow the stream?

Choices

The northeast stream reaches the collapsed cavern, area 18.

The stairway east reaches the north barracks, area 11.
